status: registered before any v5 episode is scored; freeze5.json holds the digests of this file, prepare5.py, world5.py and run5.py before the v5 run
motivation_from_v4: v1-v4 purified the dual-core estimand on this task (README section 3.5): floor 0 certified, realistic dual core 0 certified at tau <= 21, oracle 98.8% certified at 0.2% wrong with 2.3 measurements. Two mechanisms were measured: (1) margin-optimising acquisition destroys margin calibration (Goodhart; the policy selects on the confidence statistic itself), and (2) the kNN profile channel helps prediction (beta = 0.25 in 3/5 folds) but not enough for certification. v5 attacks exactly these two mechanisms with a learned world and non-margin acquisition, extends the tau grid, and registers the genetic tier as a gated phase
inherits_from_v2_v3_v4: data, units, folds, classes, menu pool, per-episode menu, charged-QC rule, budget 16
the score-margin validator and per-arm tau calibration on training-fold split halves
the planner skeleton: softmax belief over all classes, top-H = 8 working set, K = 7 quantile points

non-v5 arms are imported unchanged from the frozen v3/v4 runs: oracle, planner_reference, fixed_informative, random, planner_shuffled, planner_profile, planner_profile_masked, planner_profile_shuffled

changes_vs_v4.tau_grid: extended from (0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21) to (0,1,2,3,5,8,13,21,34,55); selection rule unchanged (smallest tau with >= 20 decided calibration episodes and wrong rate <= 0.05)
changes_vs_v4.calibration_base: split-half calibration kept identical to v2-v4 for comparability; leave-one-unit-out calibration thickening is NOT done (it multiplies cost and cannot rescue a thin base, which is thin because few episodes reach extreme margins, not because episodes are few)
changes_vs_v4.world: world5 replaces the kNN kernel with a learned linear-Gaussian completion and a precision blend (below)
changes_vs_v4.acquisition: three rules compared on the SAME world5: margin (v4 rule, control), mi (expected class-entropy reduction), thompson (sampled-class margin)

world5_learned_channel.basis: per fold: centre the training compounds' AUC matrix on the menu pool by per-line median, median-impute missing entries (basis-fit approximation, registered), truncated SVD at rank r; components scaled so training coefficients have about unit variance, giving a calibrated N(0, I) latent prior
world5_learned_channel.noise: per-line residual variance tau2(L) of the training reconstruction, floored at 0.05^2 (the validator's scale floor)
world5_learned_channel.in_context_completion: given purchased readings a_J at lines J, exact Gaussian posterior over the latent coefficients: Prec = V_J' diag(1/tau2_J) V_J + I, mean w = Prec^-1 V_J' ((a_J - centre_J)/tau2_J); predictive at line L: p(L) = centre_L + V_L w with var v(L) = tau2_L + V_L Prec^-1 V_L'
world5_learned_channel.precision_blend: per hypothesis c and line L the world predictive precision-blends the class template with the completion: mu = (m_c/s_c^2 + p/v) / (1/s_c^2 + 1/v), s^2 = 1/(1/s_c^2 + 1/v). The blend weight adapts per line and per step; world4's fixed beta is the special case with constant v
world5_learned_channel.cold_start: with no purchased readings the posterior is the prior, v(L) is large, and the blend is template-dominated
world5_learned_channel.rank_selection: r in {4, 8, 16} per fold by simulated-episode log-likelihood: for each training compound, a deterministic (SHA256-ordered) set of 4 lines is treated as purchased, the posterior is computed, and the own-class precision-blended predictive is scored by Gaussian log-likelihood on the compound's remaining measured pool lines
world5_learned_channel.basis_leakage_approximation: for rank selection each training compound contributes one of about 400 rows to the basis it is scored against; held-out evaluation compounds never contribute to any basis
world5_learned_channel.masked_control: planner_learned_*_masked runs the same planner with the compound's purchased readings replaced by another held-out compound's readings at the same positions (permuted within fold)
world5_learned_channel.shuffled_control: planner_learned_*_shuffled runs the episode on readings permuted between episodes within the fold

acquisition_rules.margin: the v4 greedy expected-margin rule, ported unchanged; the Goodhart-positive control
acquisition_rules.mi: expected class-entropy reduction: for each candidate line the reading distribution is the belief-mixture of the world's per-hypothesis Gaussians (top-H = 8, K = 7 quadrature per component); pick the line maximising H(belief) - E[H(belief | reading)]. The objective never references the margin statistic, which is the registered hypothesis for why margin calibration can survive it
acquisition_rules.thompson: sample a class from the full 39-class softmax belief (seeded per arm, compound and step), then pick the line maximising the expected margin OF THE SAMPLED CLASS under the world's predictive for that class (K = 7 quadrature; validator templates in the margin, as in the oracle's rule with the truth replaced by the sample). Randomisation decorrelates selection from the realised margin statistic; variance-inflated/optimistic Thompson variants restore valid adaptive inference in bandit theory (Yan and Zhong, COLT 2026, arXiv:2602.06014), which motivates the arm

arms.tau: each realistic arm gets its own calibrated tau per fold; masked and shuffled arms inherit their realistic arm's tau

dual_core_questions: certification: does any realistic arm reach a finite tau with held-out conditional wrong <= 0.05 and coverage >= 0.20
channel value: best realistic - planner_reference correct decisions with a bootstrap interval
compound specificity: best realistic - its masked control
Goodhart test: (mi or thompson) - margin certified-correct on the same world; does a non-margin objective certify where the margin objective cannot
efficiency: measurements per decided episode against the oracle's 2.3
gate_v5: at least one realistic arm: finite tau, held-out conditional wrong <= 0.05, coverage >= 0.20
best realistic - planner_reference > 0 correct decisions (bootstrap interval reported)

phase_G5_genetic_tier.status: registered, gated: the genetic arms run in a fold only if at least one realistic arm reaches a finite tau in that fold's split-half calibration (a calibration-side condition, known before any held-out episode is scored; held-out outcomes never decide what runs); if no fold qualifies, phase G5 is reported as blocked. The genetic channel fit (this section) is computed and reported unconditionally
phase_G5_genetic_tier.data: data/raw/depmap/CRISPRGeneEffect.csv (Chronos), sliced to the menu pool lines with CRISPR x the primary target genes of the registered classes (prepare5.py, annotation-only class-to-gene map: mode of the first-listed target symbol among the class's pack compounds; no reading data enters the map)
phase_G5_genetic_tier.channel_fit: per fold and class c with a mapped gene g_c: pooled OLS of training compounds' AUC on D(L, g_c) over (compound, line) pairs, versus the class template predictive; the genetic model is kept for class c only if its training log-likelihood improves (delta > 0), the same keep-if-it-helps discipline as v3's lambda and v4's beta. Reported unconditionally: per-class delta LL and beta sign
phase_G5_genetic_tier.genetic_action: a menu action (L, g), cost 1 budget unit, reveals D(L, g); for every class c with g_c = g the world's class term at L becomes the kept genetic regression N(alpha_c + beta_c D, sigma_c^2) replacing the template inside the precision blend. A genetic reading never enters the validator: its value flows only through acquisition (feature-cost acquisition; the 1:1 cost against a viability curve is a favourable-to-genetics bound, registered, so any positive is read as an upper bound on channel value)
phase_G5_genetic_tier.genetic_menu_restriction: candidate genetic actions per step are (L, g_c) for L in the top 20 lines by current viability MI and c in the top-H working set with a kept genetic model; deterministic given the state
phase_G5_genetic_tier.genetic_acquisition: one-step value of information: score(L, g) = E_d[max(MI_L(d), MI*)] - MI*, where MI* is the current best viability-line MI, d ranges over the K = 7 quadrature of the D-prior N(mu_g, sd_g^2) (pool-line marginal, prepare5), and MI_L(d) is the MI of a viability purchase at L after applying the reveal. Buy the genetic action only if its score is positive and exceeds every viability line's MI gain is NOT required; the rule buys argmax over the joint menu of (viability MI, genetic score) with genetic scores compared on the same scale
genetic_questions: does the agent ever buy genetics (purchase rate)
certified decisions and viability curves per certified decision versus planner_learned_mi at matched budget

conditional_unlocks.llm_agent: the tau-gated llm_agent arm (protocol.json phase B; DeepSeek via .env, seeded, spend-capped, logged) runs if and only if gate_v5 check 1 passes, at the best realistic arm's tau; the owner has approved this unlock

literature_position_verified_2026-09-28: BATCHIE (Tosh et al., Nat. Commun. 2025, doi:10.1038/s41467-024-55287-7): Bayesian active learning for screens optimises model information with a tensor-factorisation world; v5's mi rule is the same objective family aimed at a certified decision with abstention, not model fit

Yan and Zhong (COLT 2026, arXiv:2602.06014): optimism/variance inflation stabilises Thompson sampling for valid adaptive inference; motivates the thompson arm as a calibration-preserving selection rule

Kinome inhibition states (PLoS Comput. Biol. 2023, PMC9983880): DepMap CRISPR/CNV/proteomics features did not significantly improve viability prediction over expression and kinome features; a registered prior that the genetic channel's static-feature value is small, which is why G5 enters as a gated buyable measurement with an explicit keep-if-it-helps fit rather than a default feature

Active feature acquisition (Shim et al., NeurIPS 2018; Bingham, medRxiv 2026, EIG-Cost): test-time feature purchase with cost-penalised information gain is an established estimand; G5's novelty is not the estimand but placing it inside a certified-risk elimination contract with an abstaining floor and an oracle ceiling
honesty_contract_additions: the genetic channel fit is reported unconditionally so a blocked phase G5 is still informative
the 1:1 genetic cost bound favours genetics; a null genetic result under a favourable bound is strong evidence the channel is not decision-grade on this task
no v5 result is a promotion recommendation for src/; the production path is untouched
